page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hpc8i.32xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8575C processors operating at a clock speed of 2.8 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a high-capacity baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed network interface, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, high-performance computing tasks, and distributed memory caching. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants.
